name: hovercard1
title: Image Hover Card
description: A wide image card of a glossy red 3D object with a black name pill at the lower left and a round arrow button at the lower right that stretches into a Visit label on hover.
use: A portfolio or showcase grid needs image cards with a compact link that stays tidy at rest.
avoid: On touch screens the Visit label never expands, so the button reads only as a bare arrow.
a11y: The Visit label appears only on hover and the button has no accessible name at rest; the photo's alt text is just 'image'. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide card filled by a crimson-lit photo of a glossy red abstract form, rounded at the corners. A black pill reading 'Distrokings' sits at lower left and a dark circular arrow button at lower right, both floating over the image.
behaves: Hovering the round button stretches it sideways to reveal the word Visit beside the arrow, while the photo itself eases from a slight zoom back to full size. Moving away collapses the button to its arrow.
customise: The image URL, the 'Distrokings' label and the button text are hardcoded; the black palette and rounded shapes need editing in the file. No props.
weight: light: One image and CSS width and scale transitions; nothing runs until hover.
demo: Photo of a glossy red abstract sculpture, name pill 'Distrokings'.
issues: The image alt text is only 'image'.
The Visit label is hover-only and the button lacks an accessible name.
polishWhy: Bold red image and tidy label; the button is a bare arrow until hover and alt text is generic.
